reason: We tried Jamku and desktop ERP before, and my staff completely abandoned them within two months because article clerks rotate constantly and retraining them is an ongoing headache. Even with pre-loaded statutory blueprints, introducing yet another software tool when trainees already struggle to keep up adds unnecessary operational friction.
objection: My article clerks rotate every 2-3 years; training them on complex software is a waste of time.
would_change_my_mind: If it works seamlessly inside WhatsApp without making my staff learn a new interface, and automatically eliminates my two hours of Saturday GST reconciliation.
